cells.forex: Major pairs are often heavily traded, but [[liquidity]] can thin out in quiet hours, on holidays and around big news.
cells.stocks: Large, well-known companies are often heavily traded; smaller ones can be thin.
cells.penny_stocks: Often thin: little trading one day, a sudden rush the next, and it can be hard to sell.
cells.commodities: Varies widely between commodities, products and times of day.
cells.futures: Often concentrated in one or two contract months; far-dated months can be thin.

caveat: No market is always liquid. Liquidity depends on the instrument, the time, the venue and current conditions, and it can vanish in a fast market.
